roles.TRAIN_GEOMETRY: inner-train subject identities, both sessions; only fitting population
roles.CHECKPOINT_VALIDATION: inner-val subject identities; participated in checkpoint selection, report separately
roles.OUTER_DEVELOPMENT: outer-dev subject identities; primary subject-disjoint evaluation, no fitting

geometry.whitening: PEEH fixed-seed top active subspace, rank20 cap, eigen floor
geometry.protected_selection: existing persistence-supported and positive absolute/excess CE-harm 95pct lower CI convention, fitted anew on TRAIN_GEOMETRY
geometry.intermediate_P: TRAIN_GEOMETRY subject-session-class centroid PathFit to the new final-P coordinates; not independent biological persistence

analysis.decoder: StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN only, L2 logistic regression C=1, fixed; target decoder never refit
analysis.interpretation_rule: Conservative conjunction of semantic, frozen-decoder and held-subject transform evidence; ambiguity yields diagnostic-only or mixed label, not a causal claim

historical_exposure_note: Canonical checkpoint inner-val used for checkpoint selection. Any historical outer-dev inspection in prior analysis artifacts is disclosed separately and not used for current fitting.
